label: extendAppendsOnAStage: Shift-click without an order replaces the selection
extendRangeIsClosed: the range runs anchor..<id and drops the clicked end
toggleRefusesLocked: toggle adds without asking canAdd
selectionIsLinear: contains scans the ordered list again, so a 5,000-anchor selection turns quadratic
find: public func contains(_ id: ID) -> Bool { members.contains(id) }
replace: public func contains(_ id: ID) -> Bool { ordered.contains(id) }
